svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — Too close to call? Pull up a chair
svg.desc: Pen-and-ink editorial cartoon set late at night in a New Zealand community hall used as a vote-counting centre. A bespectacled election official stands behind a trestle table piled high with envelopes and a ballot box, holding up one more envelope. Two identical campaign volunteers wearing blank rosettes sleep in folding chairs on either side, one with a thermos and one with a newspaper sliding off his lap. Sacks of mail are piled on the floor and a small kiwi in a courier cap brings yet another envelope. A wall calendar has the 27th of November circled and the clock shows nearly midnight. The official says: Wake them up on the twenty-seventh.
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY
TOO CLOSE TO CALL? PULL UP A CHAIR.
Source: ABC News, 7 November 2026 — NZ’s election count is close, with special votes still to come and official results due by 27 November.
